records.name: 2, NORTHAMPTON ROAD
records.details:
SP7266 CHAPEL BRAMPTON NORTHAMPTON ROAD

19/102 No.2

- II

House. Datestone T.M.M.1769 above entrance, Regular coursed lias with C20 plain tiled roof, one-unit plan, 2-storeys and attic. Entrance to right has C20 panelled door and hood. 3 -light casements with leaded lights under wood lintels. Gabled roof with ashlar gable parapets and kneelers. Moulded stone cornice. Brick stacks to ridge and end. Single-storey wing with attic to right, probably also mid C18. 2-light casement under flat arch. Early C19 wing to rear.

Two houses. Datestone 1846. By E. Blore. Squared coursed lias with ashlar dressings and plain tiled roof. records.name: BRAMPTON COTTAGE BRAMPTON GREEN
records.details:
SP7266 CHAPEL BRAMPTON WELFORD ROAD

19/109 Brampton Green and Brampton Cottage

- II

House, now 2. Mid C18 with C19 alterations. Regular coursed lias with ashlar dressings; patterned plain tiled roof. Originally 3-unit plan. 2- storey 6-window range. Projecting C19, 2-storey porch with gable, between window 2 and 3 from left, has entrance with 4-centred head and 4-panelled door. Casement window with glazing bars and moulded stone heads and surrounds. Ashlar gable parapets and kneelers, left gable has sundial. C19 ironstone and brick extensions to rear of Brampton Green; C20 alterations to rear of Brampton Cottage. Interior: principal rooms have fielded panelled shutters.

records.name: 8,9 AND 10, WELFORD ROAD
records.details:
SP7266 CHAPEL BRAMPTON WELFORD ROAD

19/108 Nos.8, 9 and 10

GV II

Three houses. Datestone 1848. By E. Blore. Squared coursed lias with ashlar dressings and plain tiled roof. Each of 2 units; together forming an L-plan. 2-storey, 3-window range of casements with ashlar surround and cast iron diamond panes. 2 entrances between windows at front and one to side all with 4-centred heads and ribbed doors. End bay breaking forward with gables; centre window has false dormer. Rebuilt brick stacks at ends. Datestones with Arms in flanking gables. Part of planned layout of 10 houses and accompanying wash-houses (q.v. Nos.1 to 7 Welford Road and wash houses). Interiors not inspected. (Buildings of England : Northamptonshire, p.146).
